title: fimbriella lacera
intro: Fimbriella lacera, commonly known as the 'carrion flower,' is a unique, parasitic plant that obtains its nutrients by connecting with the roots of a host plant. The health benefits of Fimbriella lacera include its potential to be used as an antimalarial agent, due to its ability to inhibit the growth of the malaria parasite. The therapeutic actions of Fimbriella lacera are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids, terpenoids, and saponins. However, more research is needed to fully understand the bioactive constituents and therapeutic potential of this plant.
